title: The Invention of Wings
author: Sue Monk Kidd
summary: In early nineteenth-century Charleston, Sarah Grimké is given ten-year-old Handful as a gift. The two narrate decades of their lives, one fighting slavery as an abolitionist, the other for freedom.
readIf: you like moving historical novels based on real people that follow women for many years.
skipIf: you prefer lighter reading or avoid depictions of slavery and cruelty.
